title: Every Derbyshire UFO 'sighting' in last five years including 'perfect triangle' above town
excerpt: There have been multiple 'sightings' this year - including mutliple 'triangular shaped' objects
content:
Unidentified Flying Objects (UFOs) and potential signs of otherwordly life are claimed to be seen by Derbyshire residents every year - and our interactive map highlights reported extraterrestrial hotspots across the county.

Nearly 2,000 UFOs have been documented and logged in the UK over the last five years by research group UFO Identified - with more than 40 logged in Derbyshire.

Earlier this year, a "perfect triangle" was seen speeding across the sky above Chesterfield back in May - just weeks after a "large white triangle" was seen hovering 500ft above local playing fields in Dethick, near Matlock, in April.

Heading south, Derby city centre itself hasn't seen any reports in the last five years, and the only report in the Derby area came in Boulton Moor back in 2021, when a "bright sliver disk" streaked across the sky.

It apparently stopped for four to five seconds, then shot upwards at speed.

As expected, the Peak District has a few additions in the list, with the most recent coming near Hathersage in October, last year.

A round metal object, with a very highly reflective silver dome, was seen "really close" to the top of some trees.

"It stopped me in my tracks and I was transfixed watching this thing move," the report says.

"It was not a drone it was not a party balloon it was metal, I could clearly see it was metal. It seemed to have squares [across the surface], that's where the reflection part was coming.

"Maybe be roughly 10cm x 10cm. After around 30 seconds it just shot off in a sideways direction."

These are just a few examples of the frightful - or exciting - reports.

Take a look at every UFO 'sighting' across Derbyshire since January 2021 with our interactive map below:

Many British accounts closely mirror sightings reported across the Atlantic.

The Pentagon recently published its latest release of declassified files on Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena (UAP – the American term for UFO), following an executive order signed by Donald Trump.

Among the documents is an account from two federal agents stationed at a US "sensitive national security site" in June 2026.

According to the report, a matte-black triangular object with an estimated 15-foot wingspan hovered silently roughly 300 feet in the air for 20 seconds before descending into a canyon at high speed without leaving an exhaust trail.

While orbs, spheres and "star-like" sightings make up the bulk of British sightings, researchers have logged 164 reports of similar wedge-shaped objects – meaning roughly one in every 12 sightings involves a distinctive triangle.

Witnesses across the country have reported seeing dark, matte triangles gliding soundlessly at low altitude over housing estates, farmland, and coastal areas before darting away at incredible speeds, just like the sighting made by federal agents in the USA.

One can only wonder if the "perfect triangle" spotted above Chesterfield was the same object seen across the globe.
